sentences.japanese: この本を読んで益するところがあった。
sentences.english: I profited from reading this book.

sentences.japanese: 私から見れば、車は益よりも害を与えるほうが多い。
sentences.english: From my point of view, cars do more harm than good.

sentences.japanese: 今彼を説得して何か益があるだろうか。
sentences.english: Will it do me any good to try to persuade him now?

sentences.japanese: 人口が益々増える一方です。
sentences.english: The population just keeps growing and growing.
